generated.details: On the near-left tabletop, beside the laptop within reach, place a compact white ceramic watercolor palette with shallow pigment wells surrounding a recessed mixing area.
Three paintbrushes lie flat alongside it, their wooden handles joined by metal ferrules to tapered bristle bundles.
At far left against the rear wall, partly cropped, a simple metal drying rack has upright supports joined to a stable footed base and spaced horizontal wire shelves.
Blank off-white material sheets rest separately on those shelves, with thin edges and slight natural curl.
